title: Ninggerum language
description: Ok language of Indonesia and Papua New Guinea
extract: Ninggerum is one of the Ok languages of Papua New Guinea and South Papua, Indonesia. In Indonesia, the language is called Ningrum and is spoken in Kampung Jetetkun, Kampung Binkauk, and Kampung Detaw in Boven Digoel Regency.
